title: Restore Mac routine mailbox relay after restart with current authenticated recovery evidence
outcome: Routine mailbox relay from Central to the existing Mac runner principal works again, supported by current authenticated-link, native session-directory and recipient/wake evidence. The build, process-start and transport failure/recovery chronology is recorded without presuming enrollment loss; existing peer identity, enrollment and authentication protections remain intact.

The failure/recovery chronology distinguishes observed build, process-start and transport stages; any remaining cause uncertainty is explicit, enrollment/authentication fences are preserved, and no unapproved configuration change, re-enrollment, remote command, restart or install is used.
